# Central Coast Scan

> Matterport 3D scanning service based in Morro Bay, California. Delivers 3D virtual walkthroughs, 2D schematic floor plans, E57 point clouds, Revit/BIM-ready files, as-built drawings and permit-ready documentation for engineers, architects, builders, contractors and homeowners.

- Founder: Jimmy Daoutis, engineering draftsman with 11+ years of experience; performs every scan on site and advises on California building permit requirements.
- Service area: San Luis Obispo, Santa Barbara, Monterey, Kern and Ventura counties (within ~3 hours of Morro Bay).
- Turnaround: standard 3–5 business days; 48-hour expedite available.
- Mailing address: PO Box 1441, Morro Bay, CA 93443
- Email: hello@centralcoastscan.com
